title: Stop a dense multi-request turn at its verified native prefix
detail: A genuine receiver with eight independently accepted uploads exposes a partial first page inside a G8 multi-request turn. The old loop proceeds to a later request whose after position lies beyond the prepared prefix. Reuse the one current-request decode and stop the page loop when the last prepared position is below that request’s end. Later turns obtain fresh evidence for the remainder. Every other runtime byte is identical to phase421: signatures, expiry, chain, authority stamp, witness, native atomic commit, promotion, limits and erasure stay unchanged. Existing native helper functions are shared without AST changes, and both prior native case bodies remain byte-identical. The read-only syntax observer adds publisher and original request coordinates only. No trust is derived from those observations.
validation: The new native case fails on the pre-repair build: only the first upload is visible, then the shell and its Worker disappear. That run has no captured internal exception, so the exact exception is not independently attributed. The loop’s gap is established by source review; the narrowly repaired build passes the discriminating journey with all eight confirmed positions, actual width4/count2 native extents, unchanged observed storage and exact offline cold export. Both prior interior-cut/31s-expired-request/Undo/cold cases also pass: 53,669ms and54,823ms; new case27,207ms. All three use the rebuilt repaired source and existing120s case/15s cold deadlines. Affected162 unit cases, types and full330files/3,210pass/one existing skip pass; suite138.59s, command139.395s under approved240s full-unit guard. Quality/format,17registry checks, inventory and10controls pass. One runtime hash changes, no domain/site/construction moves; one new required native case, all prior inventory obligations preserved. An initial reviewer syntax typo and a bookkeeping script’s obsolete run path are corrected before any canonical bookkeeping write; both development failures are retained in notes.
summary: The before-failing eight-upload native regression passes after a loop-control-only repair; all three native cases and the330-file full unit checkpoint pass. Existing helpers/case bodies and every other runtime byte are independently checked unchanged.
limitations: This is bounded correctness evidence, not final-image, RAM or performance acceptance. Binary retained-reading installation, every floor rewrite/lost reply, frozen old Page/Worker/stale tabs, actual stale-turn idle audit, B fairness/past-index and the same-tree writer-off rollback image remain. Stage5/6 are not complete. No format/trust/server/wire/limit/deadline change, commit, publication or deployment.
decisionTitle: Leave an uncommitted page suffix for a fresh receive turn
decision: A verified partial page authorizes only its contiguous prefix. Stop the current multi-request turn at that boundary rather than weakening the next request’s prefix guard. Keep all verification and native commit checks byte-identical, and prove continuation and exact cold writing on actual Workers. Share existing regression helpers while retaining their ASTs and prior case bodies.
